canonical_statement: For a real-valued process on nonnegative real time over a filtered probability space, if the process has continuous sample paths, starts at zero almost surely, and both X and t |-> X_t^2 - t are martingales for the filtration, then its increments after time s are independent of the sigma algebra at s and have centered Gaussian law of variance t-s.

X is a martingale relative to F and P
t |-> X_t^2 - t is a martingale relative to F and P
conclusion: Continuous paths and zero start, and for every s <= t the increment X_t-X_s is independent of F_s and has law gaussianReal 0 (t-s) under P.
